# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Run jobs on standard GitHub-hosted runners: `ubuntu-latest` (Linux, and the Wine-based Windows signal) and `windows-latest` (native Windows). The pull-request `windows` job is the deliberate exception: it runs Windows Node under Wine on hosted Linux and blocks `all checks passed`. `ci.yml` is pull-request-only; the `wine-apt-cache` seeder lives in `ci-master.yml` (master-push only). Because `ci-master.yml` does not listen to `pull_request`, the seeder never appears in PR check panels (a job a workflow defines for a given event is listed and shows `skipped` when its `if` is false).
